timingDefinition.inputToReceipt: driver send to first ready remote snapshot containing actor after observed stop
timingDefinition.acceptedToReceipt: signed first receipt minus API publish-promise completion, same monotonic clock; may be negative
timingDefinition.handler: command execution including authority and publication, queue reported separately

runtime.memoryScope: in-process production route plus driver, not API-only RSS

sampledMemory.workPeaks: sampled only; source caps independently reviewed
